chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Khalid ibn Jarir from Abu al-Rabii said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about the *sa'ibah*, so he said: 'A man frees his slave boy and says to him,

key_terms.اَلسَّائِبَة: A specific type of manumission where the freed person is released from inheritance and debt obligations

ai.seo_question: What is the legal ruling for freeing a slave with the declaration of no inheritance or debt liability?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that *sa'ibah* is a valid form of manumission where the master releases the slave with the declaration of no inheritance claim or debt burden, contingent upon the presence of two witnesses. This ruling highlights the juristic distinction between *sa'ibah* and other forms of freeing slaves, emphasizing the contractual nature of the emancipation in Shia fiqh as recorded in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*.
